svg.title: SkyHarbor Global – Scoped Architecture Diagram Index
svg.desc: Four scoped architecture domain panels for SkyHarbor Global: (1) Digital Airline Channels, (2) ERP and Back-Office, (3) Data and AI Platform, (4) Mainframe and Private-Cloud Infrastructure. Planning-grade interpretation based on applications_systems, data_assets_integrations, infrastructure_platforms, and relationship_edges sources. Synthetic demo dataset – not a real airline production record.
svg.text: Integration Fabric — API Gateway · MQ · REST · Streaming events
